{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue and remove refunded orders
completed = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
completed['revenue'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for new customers and paid_search channel
new_paid_search = completed[
    (completed['customer_segment'] == 'new') & 
    (completed['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = new_paid_search['converted'].mean()

# Check if the population is non-empty
n_new_paid_search = len(new_paid_search)

print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid search: {n_new_paid_search}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_rate"}
